title: Golden descent and operator realizations of the Clebsch cubic
description: This preprint traces the golden orientation of the Clebsch cubic from Hitchin's incidence cover, whose rational square class is 5J0, through a six-point conference operator with square 5I. Its triangle, middle-exterior, commutator-Pfaffian, and determinant shadows recover the classical Joubert--Segre and Segre--Igusa constructions, while a degree-six Petersen/Gaunt realization returns the same Clebsch invariant harmonically. The marking boundary is explicit, and replayable exact computations accompany a partial formal companion.
